turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on writing short sentences with capitals and full stops?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes. Remember: start every sentence with a capital letter and end it with a full stop. Write "I" as a capital letter too. Use am, is, are, have or has in each sentence.

Example: Our neighbour is old. He has a big garden.

Now you try. Write 2 sentences about your neighbour.
